name: kickoff_standard_diagonal_rush_pays_both_cars_equally
description: Both cars start on the real diagonal kickoff spots, (-2048, -2560) and (2048, 2560), facing the ball with a full tank (boost 100), and boost straight at it. Measured in the engine: they first touch on frame 31 (2.07 s). They touch on the same step, so both are paid 1 - 31/45 = 0.3111 (+18.7 at weight 60). HISTORY (fixed 2026-11-02): the window was 30 steps, so this best straight-line kickoff paid nothing; and before the same-step rule only the lower player index would have been paid.

expect.intent: nobody can touch the ball before step 29 from this spot (3277 uu away)
blue touches the ball at about step 31
the best straight-line kickoff pays 1 - k/45 for k about 31: about 0.31
orange touches on the same step and is paid the same: a tie is not a win for blue
about +18.7 weighted for the fastest real kickoff touch
